debug.description: Whether to enable verbose debug logging to syslog. Enable only for troubleshooting.

max_enroll_retries.description: Maximum number of fingerprint enrollment attempts allowed per user before requiring admin intervention.

enroll_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which the enrollment retry counter resets for a given user.

policies.description: Authentication policies defining how many fingers must be enrolled or verified. Each entry defines a policy name and required finger count.

required_fingers.description: Number of fingers required for verification under this policy.

auto_resume.description: Whether fingerprint devices should automatically resume operation after system suspend/resume.
